name: ChatGPT

cost.freeTier: A Free plan is listed on the pricing page. Its feature lines include unlimited text chats with the current model and limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research and memory.
cost.paidNote: Paid plans named on the pricing page are Go, Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise. No prices appeared in the page as it was fetched, so none is recorded. No paid plan is needed for our courses.

consentRule: Under-18s need a parent or legal guardian's permission. OpenAI's Europe Terms of Use, which apply to people living in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK, say a user must be at least 13 (or the minimum age required in their country to consent to use the services), and that anyone under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian's permission.
notes: To verify before publish. Facts below were read from OpenAI's own pages on 16 November 2026 and each has an evidence entry. openai.com refuses direct automated requests (HTTP 403), so the pages were read through a fetch tool that returns extracted quotes: a reviewer should check each quote against the live page. No effective date was visible on the Europe Terms of Use as fetched. Because the vendor requires a parent's permission for under-18s, a reviewer will probably want the under-18 policy to be parent_consent_required; that decision is left to them. OpenAI's announcement of parental controls (29 September 2025) says a parent can link to a teen's account by invitation and can then opt the teen out of model training, among other controls. NOT verified: the help centre could not be read, so the current names and places of the data-control settings, the Free plan's message limits, and whether the Free plan still needs an account are not recorded.
